settings.name: Content ratings
settings.description: Which age ratings to show. Applies to movies and games; Newgrounds doesn't rate audio. Adult (A) content is never shown on Home.

settings.name: Show A (Adults only)
settings.description: Adults only. Needs you to be logged in, with adult content turned on in your Newgrounds account settings.
settings.warningDialog:
This shows adults-only content in search, channels, favorites and recommendations (never on Home).

It only works when you're logged in and your Newgrounds account allows adult content.
